title: Client Services Administrator
description:
- Senior Technical Administrator / Junior Paraplanner
- Offices near Horsham (Sussex)
- Boutique IFA with 400 clients
- £38k - £45k basic salary plus discretionary bonus
- 23 days holiday + bank holidays
- Pay rises per exam you pass
- Your Birthday off work
- Full study support for industry exams

My client are a boutique independent Chartered wealth planning firm with offices near Horsham who offer whole of market financial advice to HNW retirees, accumulators, local families and SME owners based across Sussex. In their current setup they manage the affairs of 400 clients with assets ranging greatly from basic cases up to £1m+ to invest. They give advice on pensions, investments, tax planning, cashflow modelling, retirement planning and protections etc. They have very longstanding relations stretching back 20 years.

The business has grown organically since its inception 20 years ago with 2 Advisers and a full team of support staff and a senior paraplanner . They place exceptional customer satisfaction at the top of their priorities resulting in a very high rate of retention. Staff are encouraged to progress and develop as both professionals and individuals via ongoing CPD and industry exams which are funded by the business. They use a variety of platforms and analytical tools but use Xplan as their main back-office system.

The Directors are creating a brand-new role for a Senior Technical Administrator who will be responsible for conducting end to end administration and also some paraplanning work supporting with the entire back-office function within the business. Duties will include suitability report writing, processing new business, ongoing client servicing, preparing meeting packs ahead of meetings, dealing with any incoming queries, drafting LOAs and LOVs and ad hoc admin support to advisers when necessary. This role is suitable for a candidate with at least 3 year of wealth management experience but team fit will be crucial for this role so a slightly more junior candidate will be considered. Full training will be provided and an induction to get you up and running.

title: Internal Sales Administrator

About Us

At Trident, we make IT a source of strength, helping organisations thrive so they can better support the people who rely on them every day.

We believe technology should empower people, strengthen organisations, and enable better outcomes. By working in true partnership with our clients, we provide reliable IT services, practical guidance, and people-focused support that help businesses succeed.

Benefits

The Internal Sales Administrator supports Relationship Managers by co-managing client accounts and delivering exceptional service. Acting as the primary daily point of contact for assigned clients, the role involves managing communications, addressing inquiries, and coordinating with internal teams to meet client expectations. - Analytical Skills: Ability to assess client feedback, requests, and opportunities to provide actionable insights.
- Customer Service: A solution-oriented mindset and commitment to providing exceptional service.

Next Steps

If you are looking for an opportunity to develop your career within a growing and people-focused organisation, we would love to hear from you. Apply today to be considered for this exciting Internal Sales Administrator opportunity.
- Submit your application along with an up-to-date CV.
- Applications will be reviewed as they are received.

title: Executive Assistant and Marketing Coordinator
description:
Brighton College is seeking to appoint an Executive Assistant and Marketing Coordinator to join the team on a permanent, full-time, term-time only contract.

Main Purpose of the Role: To provide high-quality executive, marketing and administrative support that enables the effective delivery of the College's marketing, communications and pupil recruitment activities.

The role provides proactive support to the Group Director of Marketing ensuring diaries, projects, campaigns and events are effectively coordinated and delivered. The postholder will play a key role in supporting the College's pupil recruitment objectives through the organisation of marketing activities, event coordination and stakeholder engagement.

The successful candidate will be highly organised, proactive, creative and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining the highest standards of professionalism, confidentiality and marketing execution.

General Duties and Responsibilities:

Marketing Coordination
- Provide comprehensive administrative support to the Marketing Department, ensuring the smooth day-to-day operation of marketing and pupil recruitment activities.
- Coordinate photography and videography projects, including scheduling shoots, liaising with staff, pupils and external suppliers, obtaining required permissions and ensuring all arrangements are in place.
- Assist with the organisation and delivery of marketing campaigns and pupil recruitment initiatives across the Group of Brighton College Schools, including managing requests for marketing materials, reporting on marketing initiatives and organising group wide workshops and meetings.
- Monitor and track media and press coverage, maintaining records and producing reports for senior leaders.

Events and Pupil Recruitment Support
- Support the planning and delivery of Open Mornings and other pupil recruitment activities.
- Coordinate event logistics, including schedules, venues, hospitality, signage, materials and attendee communications.
- Assist in the creation of newsletters and other marketing materials.
- Proof reading of marketing materials.
- Assist with the creation of social media campaigns.
- Ensure all images and video footage are stored, tagged and organised in our systems.

Executive Assistant Support
- Act as a key point of contact and trusted administrative partner to the Group Director of Marketing, ensuring priorities, commitments and projects are effectively coordinated.
- Manage complex diaries, schedule meetings and coordinate appointments, ensuring senior leaders are fully briefed and prepared.
- Organise internal and external meetings, prepare agendas and supporting documentation, and record and distribute actions where required.
- Provide proactive reminders, monitor deadlines and follow up actions to ensure projects and departmental priorities progress efficiently.
- Support senior leaders with confidential administrative duties, correspondence and ad hoc projects.
- Arrange travel, hospitality and logistical requirements as required.

Financial, Project and Departmental Support
- Process departmental expenses, purchase orders and invoices accurately and efficiently.
- Monitor marketing expenditure against budgets and maintain accurate financial records.
- Liaise with internal departments and external suppliers regarding orders, payments and contracts.
- Maintain organised departmental filing systems and records.
- Assist with maintaining marketing calendars, project timelines and activity schedules.
- Produce reports, presentations and briefing documents to support decision-making and departmental planning.
- Undertake any other reasonable duties requested by management to support the smooth operation of the Marketing teams.

Hours of Work

Monday to Friday 8.30am-5.00pm with a 60-minute unpaid lunch break (37.5 hours per week). This role is term-time only (33 weeks). There will also be the requirement to work occasional weekends to support events such as Open Mornings, for which time in lieu will be given.

Holidays

Holiday entitlement is included in the salary for this role. All holiday is to be taken outside of the working weeks.

Benefits
- Complimentary lunch is provided.
- Free tickets to the College's music, dance and drama performances.
- Job specific Learning and Development programme available to all employees.
- Life Cover is provided whilst working at Brighton College after successfully passing probation period.
- Contributory pension scheme with matching contributions from the employer up to 9%, which all eligible employees will be automatically enrolled into within three months of commencement of employment.
- Employee benefit and discount platform.

Wellbeing
- Subsidised gym membership for the School of Science and Sport is available, which includes access to yoga and Pilates classes, meditation sessions and use of the gym and swimming pool.
- Personalised health and wellbeing consultations.
- Generous sickness policy.
- Comprehensive wellbeing package.
- Access to books and magazines from the College Library.
